messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 15):
"""
Modification of an existing product shall be approved by PMC. An Application as specified at Annexure 3 (Form - IRDAI –HIP) of this Circular shall be filed with PMC. 7. If an Insurer does not launch the product or modified product within a period of 30 days from the date of generation of UIN, the Insurer shall be required to undertake the process for obtaining approvals of the product or the modification afresh from the PMC. II. Withdrawal of Products 1. Where Insurers wish to withdraw any product(s), add-on(s), rider(s), the same shall be informed vide Form IRDAI-HPW (Annexure – 5) within 30 (thirty) days from the date of withdrawal. 2. The decision to withdraw any Health Insurance product /add-on/rider shall be taken by the PMC.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"If an insurer fails to launch a modified product within 30 days from the date of generation of UIN, what must the insurer do?","answer":"The insurer must undertake the process for obtaining approvals of the product or the modification afresh from the PMC.","facts":["If an Insurer does not launch the product or modified product within a period of 30 days from the date of generation of UIN","the Insurer shall be required to undertake the process for obtaining approvals of the product or the modification afresh from the PMC"]},{"question":"Within how many days must an insurer inform the PMC about the withdrawal of any product, add-on, or rider?","answer":"The insurer must inform the PMC within 30 days from the date of withdrawal.","facts":["Within 30 (thirty) days from the date of withdrawal","the same shall be informed vide Form IRDAI-HPW (Annexure – 5)"]}]}
